<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>
        <data source="isbn"><label>[[wikipedia:International Standard Book Number|ISBN]]</label><format>[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn}}}|{{{isbn}}}]]</format></data>	
        <data source="issn"><label>[[wikipedia:ISSN|ISSN]]</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="issue"><label>Issue #</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>		
        <data source="prev"><label>Previous</label><default>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=prev}}</default><format>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=prev|value={{{prev|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="next"><label>Next</label><default>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=next}}</default><format>{{#invoke:PrevNext|main|mode=next|value={{{next|}}}}}</format></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:ComicMagazine|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|publisher|release date|pages|isbn|issn|issue|series|optional=no_year_check,unlicensed,prev,next|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|misc=1|unlicensed={{{unlicensed|}}}|template_name=ComicMagazine}}<noinclude>[[category:Media infoboxes]]{{Clear}}

==Usage==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. If a field is unknown, or does not apply, simply leave it empty.

<pre>{{Top|real}}
{{ComicMagazine
|image=
|title=
|publisher=
|release date=
|pages=
|isbn=
|issn=
|issue=
|series=
}}</pre>
</noinclude>
